notes.title: Update notes for October 21st
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0 adresses a few issues found in the first month of Demon Core's life.

[list]
[*] Replaced missing wall to prevent the player from falling into the endless void beneath Gray Bay.
[*] Prevented a sequence break which might have caused issues if performed accidentally.
[*] Camera sequence on being captured improved.
[*] Blocked unintended line of sight to a separate area in Access Control section.
[*] Prolonged ending cutscene a tad.
[/list]
